test_title: PYST 32: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, 'ECTOPIC' is written as ‘71’ and ‘EDIFY’ is written as ‘49’. How will 'ECONOMY' be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9949fa58d463b08d64d51d306747a9cb7276eb4fd7efe062642a7437842857af.png] 

**Logic: **Addition of the positional values of the alphabet.

'ECTOPIC' is written as ‘71’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe3b2914e475fd414be3b9ac0631eacba37b3e8205f7130b96b629ffafb47fa3.png] 

‘EDIFY’ is written as ‘49’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e40709ad885374f9b6ffc5e0bff41db74a553f3e206e2a42882e327f2cf8d6d.png] 

Similarly, 'ECONOMY' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06b5dd24b7ae0da33a8557118c6e1e7b051ba1941bb5a877537d1d9a5ac97225.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "90".
